PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),       # diff pair: moderate inversion -> low Vgs, high gm
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "itail":   (30e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),
    "gmid_p":  (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load
    "L_p":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_t":  (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),        # tail / bias mirror
    "R":       (200e3, 80e3, 400e3),
    "fc_t":    (34.5e3, 32e3, 37e3),
    "Q":       (0.6, 0.52, 0.66),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["itail"]
    ih = it / 2
    Lt = 1.0

    # ---- OTA devices (5T OTA as unity-gain buffer) ----
    mdp = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.5)
    vtail = vcm - mdp.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], Lt, it, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], Lt, iref, vds=mt.vgs)          # ibias diode
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ih, vds=0.9)

    # ---- Sallen-Key unity-gain LP (R1=R2=R, C1 feedback, C2 to ground) ----
    Q = p["Q"]
    R = p["R"]
    a = 1 / Q**2 - 2
    u = (-a + math.sqrt(a * a + 4)) / 2
    k = math.sqrt(u)                       # fc = k * f0
    f0 = p["fc_t"] / k
    w0 = 2 * PI * f0
    csq = 1 / (w0 * R)                     # sqrt(C1*C2)
    ratio = (2 * Q)**2                     # C1/C2 = 4Q^2
    C2 = csq / math.sqrt(ratio)
    C1 = csq * math.sqrt(ratio)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: non-inverting = n2, inverting = vout (follower)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "n2", "tail", "vss", mdp)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", mdp)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # filter
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm = mdp.gm
    rout = 1 / (mdp.gds + mp.gds)
    A = gm * rout
    gain_db = db(A / (1 + A))
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * (cl + C1 * 0.5 + mp.cdd + mdp.cdd))
    fc = k * f0
    x = 10 * fc / f0
    atten = 10 * math.log10((1 - x * x)**2 + (x / Q)**2)
    peaking = 0.0 if Q <= 1 / math.sqrt(2) else db(Q / math.sqrt(1 - 1 / (4 * Q * Q)))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + it)
    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": peaking,
               "gain_db": gain_db, "power": power, "gbw": gbw}
